en.ammaar-muslim: 2. [2/360] al-Kafi: Ali b. Ibrahim from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham b. Salim and Hafs b. al-Bakhtari and others apart from them both from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام that he (the Imam) said concerning the verse: “Allah erases what He wills and establishes” [13:39] -
Does He erase other than that which was established (before)? And does He establish other than that which was not there (at all)?
